meta.title: March 2025 — Home Visit to Take Statement (Body‑Worn Video not activated)

claim_summary: PC Jon Dixon attended the home address to take a statement in March 2025, but did not activate Body‑Worn Video (BWV), contrary to guidance for evidential and safeguarding encounters.
key_points: Encounter type: statement-taking at the victim’s home.
Risk context: ongoing stalking investigation; safeguarding relevance; later disputes over continuity and content of statement.
policy_context: College of Policing — BWV guidance: use in evidence-gathering and when it would provide transparency and public confidence.
Force policy (to be attached) — operational triggers for BWV activation during statement-taking in domestic/stalking contexts.

contradictions.claim: Failure to activate BWV during a key evidential interaction.
